messages:
maya: quick heads-up — after last night's IdP cert rotation some EU users saw immediate logouts and a few SCIM role updates never showed in audit. anyone else observing?

sam: reproduced. SAML flow returns success but session cookie gets cleared right away. repro on Chrome and Firefox. :confused:

jen: SCIM shows 200 for PATCHs but our audit index has no role-change events. looks like we acked the request but the role write failed when decrypting extId.

aaron: I ran the KMS rekey at ~02:11 UTC. control plane showed success but KMS p95 spiked to ~3.2s for a few minutes. could be a timing window with active decrypts.

sam: SP logs show: Session validate: KMS decrypt rpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED -> then session cleared. that explains both the bounce and missing role writes.

maya: we currently ACK SCIM PATCHes on decrypt timeout to avoid duplicate userid churn from IdP retries. that's causing silent loss. we need to change that.

jen: proposal: 1) add audit preflight event "role write pending" before mapping, 2) on decrypt timeout return 409 so IdP retries once, 3) short-term: implement cached-decrypt fallback (TTL 24h) to reduce blast radius during rotations.

aaron: I'll implement cached-decrypt fallback + 409 fallback when no cache. will open PR and canary to eu-prod.

sam: i'll add SP metric sp_kms_decrypt_timeouts and test repro with artificial delay.

maya: i'll own postmortem and timeline + graphs; include vuln-triage note that swallowing KMS timeouts is a silent-data-loss pattern.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-031-07 created: "IdP rotation overlapped KMS rekey causing decrypt timeouts -> session invalidation & SCIM role drops"

jen: long-term: coordinate rekey windows with infra, add small jitter to rotations, and adopt a single platform pattern for handling KMS failures (retry + surface to caller).

aaron: agreed. tracking action items in the incident ticket.
